description: Two accounts: the first answers 500. The upstream may have run the request before failing. Which account goes first is masked: the old core's first pick between two equal accounts changes from run to run.

error.message: The server had an error while processing your request

exceptions.reason: The old core moves on to the next account after a 500. The new core retries only failures the extension reports as retry-safe (the upstream certainly did not run the request); a 500 does not show that, so trying another account could run the request twice. The client gets the 500.
